course.title: Reinforced Concrete Structures - II
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A reinforced concrete column is required to carry an axial load of 1200 kN. The (15) architectural drawing restricts the dimension of the column to 300mm x 300mm. Design the column by WSD method with permissible compressive stress in concrete is 28 MPa, and yield stress in steel is 350 Mpa.
